summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new Ad Studio admin feature. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass covering products endpoint (10 products, auth gating for unauth + non-admin), campaign list/detail (no _id, no concepts in list, full 4 concepts with images/QC/7 checks in detail, images HTTP 200 as valid JPEGs), PUT edit hook + persistence + restore, POST select toggle both ways, POST QC re-run (fresh checked_at, ~30-60s LLM), POST regen cta (new CTA + fresh QC, ~60-90s LLM), invalid regen element → 400, unknown product → 400. Frontend: Admin login, /admin → Ad Studio tab, ad-studio-panel visible, all 10 ad-product-{key} buttons present, ad-lang-da/en + ad-generate-btn visible, ad-campaign-row-23bd028c89 clickable and loads ad-concepts-grid with 4 concept cards (all 4 angles), format tabs (ig_feed/story/fb_feed/square) all switch preview, edit flow (ad-edit-btn/ad-edit-hook/ad-edit-save) works and persists, winner button toggles Winner state, export button downloads 5 files (4 JPGs + copy .txt). No console errors, no page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ad_studio.py _parse_json boolean-precedence bug: `start = t.find('[') if t.lstrip().startswith('[') or t.find('[') < t.find('{') and t.find('[') != -1 else t.find('{')` — Python's operator precedence makes this a confusing conditional; works in practice but is fragile. Consider explicit parenthesization.
Edit endpoint appends field to c['edited'] but never removes it when admin restores the original value — flag remains sticky. Might be intentional (audit trail) but worth confirming with product.
regen endpoint clears field from c['edited'] on regen (line 477) — asymmetric with edit endpoint. Intentional?
No max campaigns cleanup: /campaigns returns limit(20) but ad_campaigns collection can grow unbounded. Consider TTL or admin delete endpoint.
Static file mount /api/uploads/ads/ — no auth on images. Fine if URLs are non-guessable (uuid-based), but campaign images are publicly reachable to anyone with the URL.
seed_data_creation: One temp signup TEST_adstudio_{timestamp}@example.com for non-admin auth test — left in DB (harmless, no reports/payments). Test edited then restored the emotional concept hook on campaign 23bd028c89. QC re-run and CTA regen made LLM calls on that campaign — QC 'checked_at' and CTA text are now different from main agent's original state (still valid, still passes structure).
